app.about.blurb: Mod manager and loader for HELLDIVERS (2015).
app.about.forLuajit: Compiles mod scripts into code the game runs.
app.about.title: About Obsidian
app.action.deployHint: Write the active profile into the game
app.action.deployUpToDate: The game already has the active profile.
app.action.deployVanilla: Nothing is deployed; the game is vanilla.
app.action.deployWaiting: Changes are waiting. Writes the active profile into the game.
app.action.deployedVanilla: No mods are on, so the game is vanilla.
app.action.playHint: Starts the game through Steam, with the mods you last deployed.
app.action.purgeHint: Remove everything Obsidian wrote into the game
app.action.purgedKept: Purged. %s files changed by another tool were left in place.
app.action.started: The game is starting through Steam.
app.crash.text: The game stopped while loading %s at the last launch.
app.crash.unclean: The game didn't close normally the last time it ran.
app.drawer.conflictsMeta: Mods lower in the load order override the ones above them. Drag mods in the list to change which one wins.
app.drawer.depMissingHint: Add this mod to the library. Deploy stops while a mod that needs it is on.
app.drawer.depsHint: Switching a mod on switches on what it needs. Switching it off switches off the mods that need it.
app.drawer.hint: Select a mod to see the options, keys and files. Drop a mod folder or .zip on the mod list to add one.
app.drawer.keyHint: Click, then press the new key. Esc cancels.
app.drawer.noConflicts: No enabled mods change the same game files.
app.drawer.noDeps: This mod needs no other mods, and no mod needs it.
app.drawer.noFiles: This mod changes no game files.
app.drawer.removeText: Delete this mod from the library and from every profile. The game keeps it until the next Deploy or Purge.
app.error.BadImage: That file is not an image Obsidian can use: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
app.error.GameFilesChanged: The game files don't match a build Obsidian knows, so it can't tell what this mod changes. If you copied a mod into the game folder by hand, verify the game files in Steam and import it again.
app.error.GameNotFound: The game was not found. Choose the game folder in Settings.
app.error.LastProfile: The last profile cannot be deleted.
app.error.NoRelease: That repository has no release with a version number.
app.error.NoUpdateAsset: The latest release has no single .zip with a mod to install.
app.error.NoUpdateSource: This mod names no GitHub repository to update from.
app.error.ProfileExists: A profile with that name already exists.
app.error.ProfileName: Use 1 to 40 characters, without \ / : * ? " < > |, and without a space or dot at either end.
app.error.PurgeStuck: Purge couldn't remove a file, so run it again with the game closed: %s
app.error.UnsupportedBuild: This game build is not one Obsidian knows, so it will not deploy to it.
app.error.UpdateLimited: GitHub's limit on update checks was reached. Try again in about an hour.
app.error.UpdateMismatch: The latest release is not a newer version of this mod, so Obsidian left the mod as it was.
app.error.UpdateNetwork: GitHub could not be reached, or it is limiting requests. Try again later.
app.folder.deleteText: The folder holds %s mods. What should happen to them?
app.folder.deleteTextOne: The folder holds 1 mod. What should happen to it?
app.folder.deleteWithModsHint: Deleted from the library and every profile.
app.folder.lockHint: Lock the folder: it keeps the name, color, place and mods it has.
app.folder.lockedHint: The folder keeps the name, color, place and mods it has. Click to unlock.
app.folder.name: Name
app.folder.newHint: Folders sort the list. Drag mods onto a folder name to put them in.
app.folder.ungroupHint: Back to the main list, outside any folder.
app.guardrails.achievementsHint: No Steam achievement unlocks, and no progress toward one is kept, so nothing done with mods earns one.
app.guardrails.always: Galactic War results and leaderboards are never sent while session mods are deployed, and Proving Grounds stays closed. That protects other players, so it isn't a choice here.
app.guardrails.consent: Allow other players' session mods in my game
app.guardrails.consentHint: When you play together, their session mods keep running and can change your game, such as enemies, damage and missions. You only matchmake with other Obsidian players. Off: their session mods switch off while you share a lobby.
app.guardrails.freezeHint: Your XP, rank, samples, unlocks, upgrades and stats stay as they were when the game started. Nothing you earn or spend is saved, so you can try anything without changing your account.
app.guardrails.lead: For the profile %s. Changes apply the next time you launch the game.
app.guardrails.stateConsentOff: Other players' session mods: not allowed
app.guardrails.title: Guardrails
app.home.subtitle: Mod Manager
app.image.chooseHint: A square image works best: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
app.modUpdates.none: Every mod is up to date.
app.mods.addHint: Import a mod from a .zip file or a folder. You can also drop them on the list.
app.mods.checkUpdatesHint: Asks GitHub for new versions of the mods that name a repository. Nothing installs until you choose to.
app.mods.emptyText: Drop a mod folder or .zip here, or bring back the Obsidian Kit.
app.mods.orderHint: Drag rows to reorder. The lower mod wins a conflict.
app.mods.profileHint: The profile in use. Click to switch, create, rename or delete profiles.
app.mods.resizeHint: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
app.mods.updateHint: Download and install this version. Deploy afterwards to use it.
app.mods.updateText: This installs version %s over version %s. Deploy afterwards to use it.
app.problem.broken: Obsidian can't read these mods, so they're left out of the game: %s
app.problem.damaged: The profile %s was damaged, so it started over. The old file is in the profiles folder.
app.profiles.colorHint: Tints the Profile button and the switches that are on while this profile is in use.
app.profiles.consentOff: Other modders can't affect the game in this profile
app.profiles.consentOn: Other modders can affect the game in this profile
app.profiles.deleteText: Delete this profile, with the load order, options and keys in it. The mods stay in the library.
app.profiles.duplicateHint: Makes a new profile with the same mods, order, options and keys.
app.profiles.exportHint: Save this profile as a ZIP to share: load order, folders, options, keys and the files of every mod that is on.
app.profiles.guardedOff: No guardrails on the account in this profile
app.profiles.guardedOn: Guardrails protect the account in this profile
app.profiles.importHint: Add a profile from a ZIP exported by Obsidian, with the mods inside.
app.profiles.imported: Added the profile %s and installed %s mods
app.profiles.importedGuardrails: %s comes with guardrails on: %s. Change them in Guardrails.
app.profiles.importedOne: Added the profile %s and installed 1 mod
app.profiles.lead: A profile keeps the load order, which mods are on, option values, keys and the Guardrails. Switching profile asks for a Deploy when the mods in the game differ.
app.profiles.name: Name
app.profiles.title: Profiles
app.report.copied: The report is on the clipboard, ready to paste into a bug report.
app.scope.clientHint: Changes only your game. Safe to play with anyone.
app.scope.libraryHint: Code other mods build on. It counts as a session mod when a session mod needs it, and as a client mod otherwise.
app.scope.sessionHint: Changes the game for the whole lobby, so it runs only when every player can run it too.
app.scope.unspecifiedHint: Its author didn't say whether it changes only your game or the whole lobby. It runs as a client mod, in any lobby, so other players may notice what it changes.
app.settings.animationsSystem: Off because Windows reduces motion. Switch them on here to override.
app.settings.backupsHint: Obsidian copies your saves before every deploy and keeps the latest ones.
app.settings.build.notFound: Choose the folder that holds the game's contents folder.
app.settings.build.unknown: This build is not one Obsidian knows, so deploys are blocked.
app.settings.dataHint: The library, profiles and save backups.
app.settings.foreign: Patches here that aren't Obsidian's: %s. Another tool or a person put them there, and Purge leaves them alone.
app.settings.noBackups: No backups yet. The first one is made at the first deploy.
app.settings.portable: Portable copy: the data folder sits beside the app.
app.settings.portableHint: Portable copy: download new versions from the releases page.
app.settings.reportHint: Copy report gives you the versions, the mods that are on and the end of the game's log, ready to paste into a bug report. Your Windows account name is left out.
app.settings.starterDone: The Obsidian Kit is back. Deploy to apply it.
app.settings.starterHint: Brings back any of them you deleted and the Obsidian Kit folder, and puts their settings back to default in the active profile.
app.settings.starterLabel: Obsidian API, Obsidian Trainer and Obsidian Quality of Life
app.settings.starterText: In the profile %s, the three mods go back to the top of the list, in the Obsidian Kit folder, with their options and keys at the defaults. Only Obsidian Quality of Life stays on, plus anything your other mods need. A mod you updated keeps the newer version, and your other mods stay as they are.
app.settings.updateMode: When a new version is out
app.settings.updates.autoHint: At startup, Obsidian installs a new version and restarts.
app.settings.updates.manualHint: Obsidian checks at startup and shows the new version here, nothing else.
app.settings.updates.promptHint: At startup, Obsidian asks before installing a new version.
app.settings.useSteamHint: Find the game through the Steam libraries again
app.status.notificationsHint: The notices shown so far, to read again
app.update.changelogFailed: Could not reach GitHub for the changelog.
app.update.failed: Could not reach the releases page. Check your connection and try again.
app.update.installing: Installing. Obsidian opens again when it is done.
app.update.text: Install it now? Obsidian closes, installs the new version and opens again.
app.update.title: Obsidian %s is out
build_unknown: Unknown game version, so no mods are running. Update Obsidian and deploy again.
campaign_not_uploaded: Progress was not uploaded to Galactic Campaign due to session mods
menu_empty: No mod has added a page.
menu_failed: This page failed to open. See the log.
menu_keys: Arrows move, Enter selects, Tab filters, R resets, Esc goes back
mod_failed: %s failed and is off until the game restarts.
session_not_cleared: Other players here run different mods, and some of yours change game files that can't be paused. Consider leaving this game.
progress_frozen: Your progression is frozen for this launch: nothing you earn or spend is saved.
achievements_blocked: Achievements are off for this launch.
uploads_blocked: Galactic War and leaderboard results aren't sent while session mods are deployed.
every_player_off: %s is off, because not every player here runs it.
proving_grounds_blocked: %s is ranked, so it's closed while session mods are in play.
